commands.desc: Browse the actual custom-card commands, their arguments and usage. Includes creation, viewing, deletion, trading and administrative assignment.
Rank members by their number of unique custom cards, with shared ranks for ties and paginated navigation.
Choose your favourite owned card. British spellings work for every command.
Add a card to your multi-card wishlist (max 25). DM when someone lists it.
Remove a card (or clear) from your wishlist.
Set or clear wishlist DMs for spawns, rotating shop offers and secondhand listings.
View unique-card collection progress and all catalog rarities.
Search normal and custom cards by full or partial name, stored alias or custom ID. Same results as /cardsearch.
List extra copies in your collection.
Global recorded catch count, last catch and completed secondhand sale prices, with pagination.
Your current and best daily spawn-catch streak in this server, with a 28-day UTC calendar image.
Personal catch totals, best day, longest streak and fastest recorded catch in this server, plus global sale records.
Daily UTC catalog spotlight with image, owned copies, collectors and available offers.
Re-upload the active card spawn image in this channel when its original image fails to display. Does not reset the catch timer.
Show the server's current spawn message progress and how many counted messages remain. This command does not advance the counter.
Browse cards from least to most owned with pagination and series filters. Duplicate has its own filter and is excluded from Ninjago.
Read-only lifetime XP, monthly Season XP, level and progress. Chat grants 20 XP once per minute; XP Potion doubles it to 40.

Monthly 50-level Season Pass with a free track and a ⭐ Bonus track — both free for everyone. Claim completed levels manually. Both tracks reset monthly (UTC); earned cards, coins and lifetime XP stay.
Confirm combining 5 extra copies into one random card of the next rarity. Keeps one of each card. Each rarity: 3/day, resets at 00:00 UTC.

Almost-complete-first albums with progress bars, personal reward statistics and Find in shops for missing cards. Browse team albums, Chima tribes, all eight Legend Beasts, all four MK Clones, Serpentine tribes, Pyro Vipers, Vermillion, families, factions (including the Council of the Crystal King), dragons (including all seven Source Dragons), season highlights and the 63-card All Elemental Masters mega collection. Seven complete-series mega albums cover Ninjago (Common, Super Rare and Mythic only), Chima, Monkie Kid, Nexo Knights, City No Limits, City Adventures and Dreamzzz. Pets Across the Realms brings together 20 pet cards. Albums are managed through /admin → Team & Tribe Albums; each collection awards its configured OBCoins reward once; already-complete collections and gift/secondhand-only cards are excluded.
Show your card stats and rank
Show or set your wishlist card
See how many unique cards you have
Find who owns a specific card
List all cards you have more than 1 copy of
Browse all cards from least to most owned, with pages and universe filters (same as !rarest)
Buy a card pack (10 cards). Special versions: Holo, Gold, Shadow, Ghost (full moon only); 20% of packs hold one Full Art. Every copy has a serial number; special versions have limited print runs.
Your pack cards by set, with special versions.
Show off a pack card (best version and lowest serial you own), framed in your equipped sleeve.
Upgrade Token (200,000 OBCoins): turn a normal pack card you own into its Holo Foil version with its own serial number. Card names forgive typos.
Your 3-card battle deck. Add holo/gold/shadow/ghost/fullart after a card to use that version.
Card battle. Against a player it is ranked (optional coin wager); alone it is practice vs the bot. Elements matter: Fire beats Ice, Water beats Fire, and so on.
Battle rating this season and the season leaderboard. The top 3 win coins, #1 gets the Champion sleeve.
Card sleeves: cosmetic frames drawn around your cards in !flex.
Clan dashboard with buttons. Same as !clan info.
Answer an invite, or join an open clan.
Member list with roles and contributions.
Show the owner, or hand over ownership.
Level up the clan, or see its perks.
Owner/officers: rename or describe the clan.
Clan stats, or the top clans.
This week's war, or past results.
Choose what the bot calls you in its messages instead of your Discord name (2-24 characters). `!nickname reset` removes it.
View a birthday, set yours (e.g. `!birthday set March 14`) or wish someone a happy birthday once per year. Automatic birthday wishes use Europe/Bucharest time.
Paginated birthday calendar or nearest upcoming celebrations, with today first. Automatic birthday wishes use Europe/Bucharest time.
Get a random truth or dare.
Ask someone out (the step before marriage).
Block roleplay and marriage proposals targeting you.
Aura farm, alone or with someone.
Get a random Truth or Dare prompt
Get a random Truth or Dare prompt
Get assigned a random elemental power
Get a random golden weapon fact
Generate a random Ninjago villain name
Ask someone to be your girlfriend/boyfriend (the step before marriage)
Check how long two users have been married
Block roleplay commands and marriage proposals from targeting you
Allow roleplay commands and marriage proposals again
Block marriage proposals with Forever Single mode
Browse every prefix and slash command.
Show your stored items and their effects.
Show your recorded asset changes and purchase receipts.
Get the link to add OpenBricks to your own server.
Turn rare-spawn and catch DMs on or off.
View this week's community recap, or the previous week. Automatically published Sunday at 23:59 Europe/Bucharest.
Browse the full lifetime update history with dates, newest first, and page buttons.
Browse all prefix and slash commands by category
Suggest an idea for the bot
Browse community predictions, fixed odds and stakes.
View a prediction and place a confirmed OBCoins bet.
Browse your prediction bets and payouts.
Search active offers, cheapest first, with pagination. Exact matches take priority; partial names are supported.
Buy one-hour Luck, Insane Luck, OBCoins and XP boosts; also Shield Protection and Stealth Gloves. Potions activate immediately and repeated purchases extend time.
Ten cards rotating every 3 hours, with 🆕 marks for cards you do not own. Items and potions are in !itemshop.
Buy from the bot shop by slot, or from a member by exact name or #listing.
List one normal card in the secondhand shop. The card is held until sold or withdrawn.
Sell cards directly to the bot using the original sale prices.
View a member's active secondhand listings, prices and dates with pagination and Most Expensive/Cheapest sorting.
Browse member listings with Cheapest/Most Expensive sorting, universe filters and a Missing only button to show cards you do not own, plus prices, sellers and dates.
Withdraw your own listing and return its card to your inventory.
Change the price of your own active secondhand listing.
Receive 1,000–10,000 OBCoins once per hour. Shared reward and cooldown with /beg; using either command blocks both for one hour.
Daily Ninja Reward: streaks, milestones, clan bonus and a Claim button.
View and claim the weekly bonus.
Wheel of Spinjitzu: OBCoins plus a card every 6 hours.
View or claim ninja missions: 100,000 daily / 300,000 weekly OBCoins total.
View or claim weekly ninja missions: 300,000 OBCoins total.
Fish every 10 minutes for one junk, OBCoin or card outcome. Persistent cooldown, statistics, cosmetic daily streak and paged leaderboard; legacy points preserved.
View your vault with Deposit/Withdraw/Upgrade buttons, or move OBCoins using the vault capacity (upgradable in 5 tiers), daily interest and rolling 24-hour withdrawal limit.
Ask an admin for a loan (any amount, 3% interest, up to 30 days), repay it, cancel a request or check a credit score.
Ninja Heist: attempt to rob someone's wallet every 10 hours. Shields block it, Stealth Gloves help.
View your weekly bonus, streak, milestones and claim button (same as !bonus)
Purchase an item from the shop or buy everything you can afford
Give cards or unique custom cards. Gift/secondhand-only cards do not count toward !teams until acquired another way.
Transfer extra copies, keeping one of every card.
Attempt a card theft every 5 hours; shields can block success.
See what cards another user has that you don't
Move your entire collection to another user
Skip an unanswered round in this channel, reveal the answer and continue without points or OBCoins. Specify a game if several are running; five-second skip cooldown.
Play the claw machine; no arguments shows options.
Roll Ninja Dice or view stats.
Play Ninja Rush; use !ninja rush for instructions.
Challenge someone to a dice duel.
Start chess or resign your game.
Make a chess move, e.g. e2 e4.
Challenge someone to Tic Tac Toe.
Browse correctly guessed CMFs by series, with repeat-guess counts, progress and an All view with Next/Previous pages. Tracking starts with this update.
Browse CMFs still missing from your recorded guesses, grouped by series. Image-pending entries are excluded.
Browse the latest CMF series and choose any other series from the menus. Image-pending entries are marked.
Leave or stop your active game.
Gamble OBCoins on a coin flip
Battle another player using card rarity
Start a Black Tea game (survival word game)
Start a Green Tea game (10 rounds)
Play Tic Tac Toe against someone
Global catalog completion ranking with percentages, distinct owned cards and missing counts. Excludes custom/unknown cards and extra copies; all acquisition methods count.
15-day server catch ranking and dated PNG progress chart with daily/cumulative catches, personal view and pagination. Recorded spawn catches only; UTC dates.
Rank members by active secondhand listings, most first; ties use total listed value.
All-time secondhand sellers ranked by completed card sales; ties use total OBCoins earned.
Link your alt to your main (run on the main, accept on the alt). The alt then plays as your main: same inventory, coins and cooldowns.
Show the alts linked to your account.
Show wins for any game: episode, quote, quiz, blacktea, greentea, location, set, minifigure, tictactoe, blackjack, chess.
Rank collectors by distinct CMFs guessed, then total recorded correct guesses. Includes progress, your position and page buttons.
Show how many members are in this server
Show tracked server messages for a user
Show tracked invites for a user
Remove every staff role (roles with moderation powers) from a member. Needs Manage Roles and a higher role than the target.
Ban a current member. Requires moderation permissions and a highest role strictly above the target.
Unban a user. Requires moderation permissions.
Stop members from talking in a channel (this one if none is given). Add a time like 10m or 2h to unlock it automatically. Staff roles can still talk. Needs Manage Channels.
Undo !lock and put the channel's permissions back exactly as they were.
Lockdown: lock every channel members can see, for example during a raid. Staff-only channels stay open. Asks to confirm first.
Undo !lockall and unlock every locked channel.
Kick a member. Requires moderation permissions and a highest role strictly above the target.
Time out a member. Requires moderation permissions.
Remove a timeout. Requires moderation permissions.
Issue a warning. Requires moderation permissions.
Remove a warning (latest, or by id from !warnings).
Arrest a member. Requires moderation permissions.
Release an arrested member or a hacked-account safety hold, restoring saved roles, nickname and access. Requires moderation permissions.
Crash: cash out before the rocket crashes. Maximum bet: 50,000 OBCoins.
Buy a lottery ticket or view the current status
Create a fake Discord-style message image
Make the bot send a hidden-style message
Review the risks, then make three wishes
Create private custom cards for 500,000 OBCoins each (unlimited)
Delete your custom card with confirmation (no refund)
